description:
Publish a matrix as a public read-only web page and return the tokenized link — or list/revoke existing share links.

Publication is a deliberate act: anyone with the link can view the matrix (title, elements, correlations, completeness score) until the link is revoked or expires. Elements marked internal (upsert_element visibility "internal") never appear, nor their correlations; hide_figures leaves out every value, target, unit and execution link. Before publishing, mark internal what must not leave the organization (prospects, salaries, anything said in confidence). The page is never indexed by search engines. Use it to share the X-Matrix with people OUTSIDE the organization (board members, investors, partners) without creating accounts. For sharing inside a claude.ai Team organization, prefer the matrix_artifact prompt instead.

Not available in local JSON mode (sovereign mode has no cloud page by design — export a snapshot artifact instead).

action.description: create (default): publish and return the link. list: existing shares with status. revoke: kill a link (requires share_id).

expires_in_days.description: Optional auto-expiry in days (default: no expiry, revocable manually)

full_sheets.description: true: the initiative pages of the link show the full sheet (owner, sponsor, who does the next action, blockers, the sentence behind the health). Only when the person asked for it, for an audience they trust (default false)

hide_figures.description: true: the page shows the structure only, no value, target, unit or execution link (default false)

label.description: Optional label to remember who this link was created for (e.g. "board Q3")

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix (default: the default matrix of the organization). Pass it as soon as list_matrices shows more than one.

share_id.description: UUID of the share to revoke (required for action=revoke, from action=list)

name: share_matrix
